title: Source
description: An information source and its compliance decision. A source is only ever collected from after the compliance gate recorded a decision on it.

source_id.description: Stable id for the source, shared across research projects.

base_url.description: Canonical base URL of the source.

domain.description: Research domain this source was discovered for.

source_type.description: Kind of source, for example official_site, media, paper, report, community.

compliance_status.description: Outcome of the compliance gate. BLOCKED means policy forbids collection; ERROR means the check failed; UNREACHABLE means robots.txt could not be read, which pauses the source rather than allowing it.

compliance_record_id.description: Id of the compliance decision record backing compliance_status.

robots_summary.description: Short human-readable note on what robots.txt allows, for audit.

terms_summary.description: Short human-readable note on terms or licence restrictions, for audit.

selection_status.description: Whether the planner chose this source for the current round.

selection_reason.description: Why the source was selected or excluded.

discovery_verified.description: True when the source existence and base URL were verified by a real request during discovery.

discovered_at.description: Timestamp when the source was first discovered, ISO 8601.

last_checked_at.description: Timestamp of the last compliance check, ISO 8601.

last_collected_at.description: Timestamp of the last successful collection from this source, ISO 8601.

notes.description: Free-form research notes about this source.
